mentions.name: Custom newspaper builder
mentions.description: A custom newspaper builder tool for designing the kids' newspaper, supporting different page layouts and reusable design elements.
mentions.problem: Traditional design tools like Photoshop don't come easy for non-designers.
mentions.audience: The author, for personally designing the kids' newspaper
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a custom newspaper builder along with it to help me design it. I'm not a designer so tools like phoshop don't ocme easy. This allows me to have different layouts for pages and create different re-usable elements.
mentions.author: wwalker2112
